description:
§22.12 "Runtime `meta.emit` output is gated" (S458 "your recs on all four" item 3 + PA-ruled S459 consequence) — a runtime `meta.emit` string carrying bare `data-scrml` (the component CSS scope root) is refused at run time: nothing is written, so no `

` appears in the host. The compile is clean — a runtime rule with no code.
rationale: §22.12 rule, Compiler-owned names: no attribute whose name, as parsed (and lowercased), is `data-scrml` or begins with `data-scrml-`; on a violation the runtime SHALL write NOTHING.
